gloss: to excel, to surpass, to stand out

definitions.gloss: to excel, to surpass others, to stand out
definitions.explanation: To be superior to others in ability, skill, or quality. A literary and somewhat formal verb, often used in the form {秀|ひい}でた (excelling, outstanding) as a modifier.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{数学|すうがく}に{秀|ひい}でている。
{秀|ひい}でた{才能|さいのう}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}だ。
examples.english: She is a person of outstanding talent.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{応募者|おうぼしゃ}の{中|なか}で、{彼女|かのじょ}の{作品|さくひん}はひときわ{秀|ひい}でていた。
examples.english: Among the many applicants, her work stood out remarkably.

notes:
USAGE:
An ichidan verb often used in the te-form {秀|ひい}でている (excels, is outstanding) or as the prenominal modifier {秀|ひい}でた (outstanding, excellent). Takes the particle に to indicate the field of excellence.

More literary than {優|すぐ}れる (to be superior), which is the more common everyday equivalent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～に{秀|ひい}でる: to excel in...
- {秀|ひい}でた{才能|さいのう}: outstanding talent
- {秀|ひい}でた{能力|のうりょく}: exceptional ability
- ひときわ{秀|ひい}でる: to stand out remarkably
